definitions.explanation: A small pool of rainwater or other liquid that has collected on the ground.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}たまり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{水|みず}たまり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing in the puddles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|や}んだ→止む：01153_yamu⟧あと、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{水|みず}たまり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After the rain stopped, large puddles had formed all over the road.

notes:
{水|みず}たまり refers to a shallow pool of rainwater or other liquid that collects on the ground, typically on roads, sidewalks, or in parks after rainfall. It is a common everyday word familiar to all ages.

ETYMOLOGY:
A compound of ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) + たまり (pool, accumulation, from ⟦{溜|た}まる→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧, to accumulate). Also written as {水溜|みずた}まり.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水|みず}たまり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: a puddle forms
- {水|みず}たまり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: to step in a puddle
- {水|みず}たまり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid a puddle
- {水|みず}たまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧: to be reflected in a puddle

USAGE:
{水|みず}たまり is the standard word for any small standing pool of water on the ground. For larger bodies of standing water, {水|みず}たまり would not be used; instead, words like ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧ (pond) or ⟦{沼|ぬま}→沼：02160_numa⟧ (swamp) are appropriate.
